Class VFMCSMapper

java.lang.Object
org.openscience.cdk.smsd.algorithm.vflib.map.VFMCSMapper
All Implemented Interfaces:
IMapper
@Deprecated public class VFMCSMapper extends Object implements IMapper
Deprecated.
SMSD has been deprecated from the CDK with a newer, more recent version of SMSD is available at http://github.com/asad/smsd.
This class finds the maximum common substructure (MCS) of a query and a target molecule using the VF2 algorithm.

getMaps(IAtomContainer) and countMaps(IAtomContainer) find the connected common substructures with the most atoms and, of those, the most common bonds; bonds may be left out on either side. At most MAX_MAPPINGS mappings are returned or counted. If the search times out (see TimeOut) the best mappings found so far are returned. A mapper made with VFMCSMapper(IQuery, long, int) has its own time limit and maximum number of mappings instead, and neither reads nor sets TimeOut. hasMap(IAtomContainer) and getFirstMap(IAtomContainer) match the whole query, as VFMapper does, with no time limit.

The search is exact. It can take long when many mappings are nearly as good as the best one, e.g. for some large polycyclic molecules, so a time limit is recommended. When the whole query does not fit, the search order is taken from the structures, so it hardly depends on the order of their atoms.

Author:
Syed Asad Rahman <asad@ebi.ac.uk>

    • VFMCSMapper

      public VFMCSMapper(IQuery query, long timeLimit, int maxMappings)
      Deprecated.
      Creates a mapper with its own limits. The global TimeOut is neither read nor set. getMaps(IAtomContainer) and countMaps(IAtomContainer) stop when the time limit is reached or the thread is interrupted, see isTimedOut(). Once maxMappings equally good mappings are found, only better ones are searched for, so a limit of 1 finds one maximum mapping fastest.
      Parameters:
      query - the compiled query
      timeLimit - time limit of each search in nanoseconds, or a negative value for none
      maxMappings - the maximum number of equally good mappings to keep, from 1 to MAX_MAPPINGS
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if maxMappings is not from 1 to MAX_MAPPINGS
